alt: Table of GTA 6 on-foot buttons: run L3 or LS, jump Cross or A, crouch Circle or B, cover R1 or RB, aim L2 or LT, shoot R2 or RT.

data.title: On-foot buttons
data.subtitle: Default layout. PS5 from Shacknews, 18 Nov 2026. Xbox = same spot on the pad.
